name: Quantile Rendering
definition: A sparse, transmittance-guided sampling strategy that selects only the most representative Gaussians along each ray for efficient rendering of high-dimensional features, avoiding the computational overhead of densely sampling all intersecting Gaussians.
summary: Quantile Rendering is a sparse, transmittance-guided sampling strategy that shifts the Riemann partition to the transmittance domain, reducing complexity by sampling only representative quantile Gaussians.
